## What changed

- kmctl now lives in `packages/kmctl`, and its APM package in `packages/kmctl/apm`. Install from `#subdirectory=packages/kmctl` and add the package with `path: packages/kmctl/apm`; pins to v0.12.2 and older keep the repository root and `path: apm`. (`kmctl-to-packages`, `apm-per-package`, `root-release-cutoff`)
- kmctl's README now carries its install and use; the repository README is a short map to kmctl, kmaudit and `docs/`. (`readmes-per-package`)
- kmctl's README and the APM how-to give the upgrade from v0.12 step by step. (`upgrade-from-v0-12-docs`)
- kmaudit, a new and separate package, checks what a folder of markdown docs claims against the code, through an MCP server and a review page. It installs apart from kmctl; see its README. kmctl's own audit (the action's `mode: audit` and `/audit`) is unchanged. (`kmaudit-package`)

## Upgrading from v0.12

Do these in order. A project made from the starter does all of it with `just upgrade v0.13.0`.

1. Install the new CLI first. A kmctl at v0.12.2 or older looks for kmctl at the repository root and cannot run a v0.13.0 pin:
   `uv tool install --force 'git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.13.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl'`
2. In `apm.yml`, change kmctl's entry to `path: packages/kmctl/apm` and `ref: v0.13.0`.
3. Run your `apm install` line, then `kmctl plugin patch`.
4. Run `kmctl doctor` last, once `apm install` has moved the lock.

The GitHub Action (`uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.13.0`) and the pre-commit hook (`rev: v0.13.0`) change only their tag.

## Other changes

- One Release workflow releases kmctl or kmaudit, each with its own version, tags and notes, committed in the version pull request; a release skill walks the steps. (`release-per-package`, `release-notes-hermes`, `release-skill`, `release-notes-owned-paths`)
- CI runs one test job per package. (`ci-per-package`)

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.13.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.13.0
```

**Full diff**: https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl/compare/v0.12.2...v0.13.0
